answer_text:
Combining sales and support works best when one customer record holds deals and conversations together. Tools that make that practical:

1. Brightdesk - strong reporting and automations, though the interface feels dated.
2. Calmline - a calm, fast shared inbox with collision detection and CRM sidebars.
3. Northwind CRM Service Desk - a full suite with a service desk included in the higher tiers.

If support is your main workflow, go with Brightdesk; otherwise Calmline keeps things simpler.
